description: React component for the host dashboard page of an auction platform. It manages auction controls, items, winners, analytics, and real-time bid updates.

methods.name: HostDashboard()
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the host dashboard with auction controls, items, winners, and analytics.

methods.name: refreshHighBid
methods.description: Fetches and updates the highest bid for a specific item.

methods.name: refreshAnalytics
methods.description: Fetches and updates bid analytics data including highest bids, bid counts, and bid time series.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Loads items for the current event, updates state, and fetches high bids and analytics.

methods.name: loadEvent
methods.description: Fetches event data by event ID.

methods.name: refreshWinnersIfClosed
methods.description: Fetches winners for the event if it is closed.

methods.name: handleAddItem
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new item to the auction.

methods.name: handleCloseItem
methods.description: Closes bidding on an item and fetches associate winner info.

methods.name: handleOpen
methods.description: Opens the auction, updating status and resetting winners.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the auction, fetches winners, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: exportCsv
methods.description: Exports the list of winners as a CSV file.
